description: This Dart source file defines the 'NoteProvider' class, which manages the state and behavior for notes in a Flutter application. It interacts with a 'NoteRepository' for data persistence, handles sorting, searching, and pinning notes, and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: NoteProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider class managing the list of notes, their sorting, searching, and pinning state.

methods.name: _loadPrefs
methods.description: Constructs preferences, loads the current sort setting from shared preferences.

methods.name: _savePrefs
methods.description: Saves the current sort setting to shared preferences.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from the repository, applies sorting, and manages loading/error state.

methods.name: _applySort
methods.description: Sorts the list of notes based on the current sort setting, prioritizing pinned notes.

methods.name: setSort
methods.description: Sets the sorting criteria and updates the note list accordingly.

methods.name: visibleNotes
methods.description: Returns the list of notes filtered by the current search query.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Creates and adds a new note to the repository and updates the internal list.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the repository and internal list.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Removes a note from the repository and local list.

methods.name: togglePin
methods.description: Toggles the pinned status of a note.
